_comment: T182 Phase 1 / T299 — the DECLARED set of projects the client-import inventory measures. Read by scripts/client_inventory.py (`just client-inventory`). The set is POLICY, not discovery: a project absent from this file is never inventoried, and a declared root that is missing or is not a git repo ROOT is a hard failure — not a skip. `role: w0m` names the project whose .w0m/sdlc.json IS the contract every other project is diffed against; exactly one is required. Canonical roles (w0m, managed, self-managed, on-prem) provide default service switches; per-project overrides carry a mandatory reason. Paths are relative to the estate ROOT (…/@wom) and MAY point outside it. Read-only by construction: this tool never writes to a client repo (T182 Phase 0, AC6).

projects.note: T294 — the estate is a WORKSPACE of seven repos, not the single repo `wom7web` it was declared as until 2026-09-02. tiers._comment: T265 AC2 — every governance surface decided IN or OUT for the half-managed tier, explicitly. A surface not named is a gap, not a default, so every one of the estate contract's 33 keys appears here plus the surfaces AC2 names that are not contract keys. The organising principle: IN if it describes the project or is read-only and is part of skills/tools/SDLC; OUT if it is ticketing (owner instruction) or requires WRITE access to something that is not ours.
